source_name: Integrity Watch Kosova (KDI / Transparency International Kosova)
why_relevant: Launched Dec 2025; combines public procurement, political financing and asset declarations with automated red-flag indicators, and shows which companies repeatedly win contracts from which institutions. Excellent for detecting incumbent lock-in and politically connected local partners in payment/IT tenders — exactly the partner-risk layer a vendor entering Kosovo needs.

source_name: Open Data Kosovo — procurement data projects
why_relevant: Civic-tech organisation that has repeatedly rebuilt and analysed Kosovo procurement datasets (including emergency procurement). Its writeups reveal dataset structures, field quirks and alternative endpoints, shortening the engineering path to reliable collection.

source_name: Ministria e Financave, Punes dhe Transfereve / Thesari i Kosoves — buyer of SIMFK (FMIS) and treasury payment systems
why_relevant: The Treasury is the state's core payments buyer: SIMFK (Kosovo Financial Management Information System) support/licensing, e-Prokurimi/SIMFK integration sub-modules, salary and pension disbursement. Public reporting already shows negotiated contracts with FREEBALANCE KOSOVA SH.P.K (approx EUR 800k support/licences; approx EUR 134,874 for the SIMFK-to-e-Procurement sub-module, Oct 2023) — a concrete incumbent to track.

source_name: Public Finance Management Strategy (Strategjia e Menaxhimit te Financave Publike) — Office of the Prime Minister
why_relevant: Forward-looking pipeline document: states planned treasury/FMIS/e-payment modernisation actions with indicative timing, which predicts upcoming tenders 1-3 years ahead of any notice appearing on e-Prokurimi.

source_name: ASHI — Agjencia e Shoqerise se Informacionit / eKosova platform (state e-services payment gateway owner)
why_relevant: ASHI runs eKosova, which takes card payments for public services from any bank — meaning ASHI procures acquiring, gateway and integration services. It is the natural buyer for state payment-gateway work and a key reference account for whichever local acquirer/PSP won it. ASHI has also been the subject of a National Audit Office IT project-management audit.

source_name: ZKA — Zyra Kombetare e Auditimit (National Audit Office) reports on procurement and IT
why_relevant: Performs dedicated procurement audits and IT audits (including an audit of IT system project management at the Information Society Agency). Audit reports name contracts, values, deficiencies and unmet specifications — often the only place where the failure and cost overrun story behind a payments/IT contract is documented.

source_name: Municipality procurement pages on kk.rks-gov.net (e.g. Prishtine, Skenderaj) and prishtinaonline.com
why_relevant: Municipalities are numerous, independent contracting authorities that buy cash-collection, POS, e-payment for utility/tax collection and banking services. They mirror notices on their own sites, which sometimes surfaces documents faster or in more readable form than the central portal, and gives a per-municipality view of local integrator penetration.

source_name: Dogana e Kosoves (Kosovo Customs) procurement notices (shared AnnouncementFiles folder)
why_relevant: Customs is a major state revenue collector and therefore a buyer of payment collection, card acceptance and IT systems. Its notices are published as directly addressable PDFs (B08 njoftim per dhenje te kontrates) in a shared folder, which is easy to enumerate.

source_name: KOSTT SH.A. tenders page (public enterprise procurement)
why_relevant: Representative of Kosovo's public enterprises (transmission operator; same pattern applies to KEK, water utilities, Posta e Kosoves). Public enterprises buy billing, collection, POS/kiosk payment and banking services, and they publish tenders on their own sites in addition to e-Prokurimi.

source_name: Trusti — Fondi i Kursimeve Pensionale i Kosoves (Kosovo Pension Savings Fund)
why_relevant: Named in the cell scope as a state-linked payments buyer: administers millions of individual accounts, runs contribution collection and withdrawal disbursement (e.g. the 10% withdrawal application platform), and tenders bank deposit placements and IT/record-keeping systems. It is subject to the Public Procurement Law, so its notices should be traceable in e-Prokurimi.

source_name: KALLXO.com / Demokracia.com / Buletini Ekonomik — investigative procurement journalism
why_relevant: Kosovo investigative outlets routinely publish contract-level detail with vendor names and values that would otherwise require digging through the portal — e.g. Demokracia's reporting of the MF negotiated contracts with FreeBalance Kosova, and Buletini Ekonomik on SIMFK security. They also flag which tenders became disputes, which is a fast triage layer over the raw notice stream.

source_name: GZK — Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikes se Kosoves (Official Gazette), public procurement legislation
why_relevant: Law No. 04/L-042 (as amended by 04/L-237) and its predecessors define what must be published, in what form, and within what deadlines — i.e. the ground truth on what evidence the market is legally obliged to emit. Essential for judging completeness of any collected award dataset and for the legal basis of collection.

source_name: Open Contracting Partnership — Kosovo country analyses
why_relevant: Explains what Kosovo actually publishes (plans, dossiers, signed contract PDFs, bidder lists) and the reform trajectory since 2016. Sets realistic expectations for field coverage and historical depth before investing in a collector.

source_name: selltostate.com guide to e-Prokurimi (vendor-side navigation guide)
why_relevant: Commercial bid-intelligence writeup describing how the KRPP/e-Prokurimi portal is structured from a supplier's viewpoint — registration, notice types, where awards appear. Useful as a navigation shortcut, but it is marketing content and its claims must be verified against the portal itself.

source_name: ARBK / KBRA – Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve të Kosovës (official site)
why_relevant: Sole legally mandated business registrar in Kosovo, under the Ministry of Industry, Entrepreneurship and Trade. Registers LLCs, JSCs, foreign companies and branches ('dega e shoqërisë së huaj'), and publishes name, legal form, registration date, address, primary economic activity and change history. This is the authoritative proof that a banking/payments vendor has a local legal footprint.

source_name: RBK – ARBK e-registration / e-services portal (rbk.rks-gov.net)
why_relevant: Transactional front-end of the registry where registrations and changes are filed; the 'Regjistrimi' path exposes entity type taxonomy (incl. foreign company / branch) and is the likely host of newer registers such as beneficial ownership filings.

source_name: Register of Beneficial Owners (Regjistri i Pronarëve Përfitues) – Law No. 08/L-265, administered by ARBK
why_relevant: UBO register makes the real owners behind Kosovo-registered vendor entities and foreign branches discoverable — decisive for telling a genuine local vendor subsidiary from a shell or a reseller fronting for a regional group. Legal basis and consultation record are public; the searchable register itself is administered by ARBK.

source_name: ARBK Open (arbk.org) – open mirror of the Kosovo business registry
why_relevant: Third-party open interface over ARBK data allowing search by registration, owners, activities and aggregate statistics — much easier than the official UI for owner-based and activity-code sweeps (e.g. finding every entity whose owner is a foreign payments group).

source_name: ARBK Atlas (arbk.atlas-studio.eu) – Kosovo business registry & intelligence
why_relevant: Commercial reindex of ~240k Kosovo companies with search, export and competitor-monitoring features. Useful for bulk sector sweeps (IT / financial services activity codes) that the official portal makes tedious.

source_name: Open Data Kosovo – 'Bizneset e Hapura' / Open Businesses
why_relevant: Civil-society platform holding ~170k ARBK-derived business records; documents the scraping methodology and is a snapshot source useful for historical comparison (when did a vendor entity first appear).

source_name: ARBK Business Registry API (xk-business.applifyer.com)
why_relevant: Documented third-party API over Kosovo business registry data — the cheapest route to programmatic, repeatable monitoring of new vendor registrations rather than manual lookups.

source_name: ARBK Business Registry API (arbk.micro-devs.com)
why_relevant: Second independent API front-end over ARBK data; having two lets us cross-validate field coverage (owners, activity codes, status) and pick whichever exposes branch/foreign-company flags.

source_name: OpenCorporates – Kosovo Business Registration Agency jurisdiction page
why_relevant: Normalises Kosovo entities into a cross-border corporate graph, so a Kosovo entity can be linked to its parent registered in Greece, Serbia, Albania, Turkey or the EU — exactly the parent/subsidiary link needed to detect regional vendor expansion.

source_name: OCCRP Aleph – Kosovo Business Registration Agency dataset
why_relevant: Bulk-indexed ARBK dataset searchable alongside leaks, sanctions lists and other registries — the best tool for entity-resolution across directors/owners and for spotting the same individual behind several vendor entities.

source_name: ATK – Administrata Tatimore e Kosovës: VAT / fiscal number verification (BizPasiveApp)
why_relevant: Lets us confirm that a registered vendor entity is tax-active (fiscal number / VAT / NRB lookup) rather than a dormant shell, and flags passive businesses. Registration alone proves intent; VAT activity proves operations.

source_name: ATK – Administrata Tatimore e Kosovës (main site, publications and business lists)
why_relevant: Publishes annual reports and lists such as businesses granted VAT relief on imports of raw materials and IT equipment — an indirect indicator of which local firms actually import banking/IT hardware.

source_name: MINT – Ministria e Industrisë, Ndërmarrësisë dhe Tregtisë (ARBK parent ministry)
why_relevant: Policy and legal layer above the registry: administrative instructions, fee schedules, registry reform announcements and statistics on registrations including foreign-company branches. Explains changes in what the register exposes.

source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (GZK) – official gazette / legislation database
why_relevant: Authoritative text of the company law, beneficial-ownership law (08/L-265), tax administration law and implementing instructions that define what the registry records and who may access it — needed to judge legal access status for collection.
